caption: Claude ko in 4 AI agents se connect karo, aur dobara kabhi ek bhi lead waste nahi hogi.
Pehla hai WhatsApp agent. Jaise hi naya lead aayega, ye turant unhe message karega, aur unki requirement samjhega.
Doosra hai calling agent. Agar WhatsApp ke baad kisi client se call par baat karni hai, toh calling agent unhe call karke, unke saare questions ke answers dega.
Teesra hai email agent, aur iske saath invoice builder bhi connected hai.
Invoice builder khud invoice banayega, GST aur total ke saath, aur email agent use saare clients ko automatically bhej dega.
Aur sabse best baat? Ye teeno agents automatically follow-ups bhi bhejte hain. WhatsApp par message, reminder call, aur payment reminder email.
Toh agar aapko bhi apne business ke liye aise custom AI agents chahiye, toh follow kar lo.
